presets.label: 2D anime cel illustration
presets.guidance: Keep drawn contours and value groups coherent; subject, anatomy and wardrobe remain separate choices.

presets.label: Flat graphic illustration
presets.guidance: Use silhouette, spacing and color relationships instead of inferred physical depth.

presets.label: Painterly illustration
presets.guidance: Describe brushwork and edge handling without assigning a subject or historical artist.

presets.label: Watercolor treatment
presets.guidance: Reserve paper, control pigment edges and keep selected regions legible.

presets.label: Ink drawing
presets.guidance: Use line density and solid masses deliberately; a comic panel is a separate presentation choice.

presets.label: Pencil drawing
presets.guidance: Choose erased light, pressure and directional marks rather than photographic texture.

presets.label: Pixel art
presets.guidance: Keep a deliberate pixel scale; distinguish artwork pixelation from output file resolution.

presets.label: Vector illustration
presets.guidance: A vector appearance does not establish that the provider returns a vector file.

presets.label: Stylized 3D rendering
presets.guidance: Choose modeled forms and material response without assuming photorealistic anatomy.

presets.label: Physically shaded 3D rendering
presets.guidance: Specify material response and lighting intentionally; this is not proof of a physical scene.

presets.label: Photographic presentation
presets.guidance: State capture and lighting intent; do not infer identity, age or scene facts from a finish choice.

presets.label: Crafted object presentation
presets.guidance: Choose the actual craft material and construction; the preset does not imply a toy subject.

presets.label: Mixed media composition
presets.guidance: Declare the participating regions and their overrides rather than averaging incompatible finishes.
